risk_transmission_channel: Forced recognition of hidden stressed corporate loans, sharp jump in slippages, surge in provisioning requirements and erosion of bank ROA.
description: RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan mandated deep-dive Asset Quality Review directing commercial banks to clean up legacy stressed corporate balance sheets by March 2017.

affected_institutions: All Banks & NBFCs (Severe impact on cash-reliant borrowers in NBFCs: Shriram, Chola, MMFSL)
risk_transmission_channel: Cash liquidity crunch caused temporary disruption in rural/informal borrower repayments, temporarily spiking 30+ and 60+ DPDs in vehicle and micro-loans, while flooding banks with low-cost CASA deposits.
description: Government invalidated INR 500 and 1,000 banknotes overnight, altering liquidity dynamics across banking and NBFC sectors.

risk_transmission_channel: Abolition of CDR, SDR, and S4A debt restructuring schemes; 1-day default reporting to CRILC; mandatory IBC referral if un-resolved within 180 days, triggering large corporate NPAs.
description: RBI introduced a strict unified framework for resolution of stressed assets, eliminating forbearance windows.

event_name: ICICI Bank Governance & Videocon Inquiry Shock
risk_transmission_channel: Reputational risk, leadership distraction, supervisory scrutiny, credit rating outlook review, and negative stock abnormal return.
description: Allegations of conflict of interest and quid-pro-quo regarding corporate loan sanctions to Videocon Group led to board-appointed independent inquiry by Justice Srikrishna.

affected_institutions: All NBFCs (Bajaj Finance, Shriram Finance, Chola, MMFSL)
risk_transmission_channel: Commercial Paper market froze, mutual funds stopped refinancing NBFC short-term debt, asset-liability maturity mismatches forced NBFCs to curb loan disbursement and hold defensive liquidity buffers.
description: Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services (IL&FS) defaulted on inter-corporate deposits and commercial paper, triggering an existential liquidity crisis for Indian shadow banks.

risk_transmission_channel: Severe economic shutdown, nationwide 6-month loan repayment moratorium, elevated probability of default, surge in Stage 2 assets, and front-loaded contingent provisioning buffers.
description: RBI slashed repo rate by 75 bps, announced INR 3.74 lakh crore system liquidity, and granted a 3-month (subsequently 6-month) moratorium on loan repayments to counter COVID-19 pandemic.

risk_transmission_channel: Allowed lenders to restructure viable personal and corporate loans impacted by COVID-19 without asset classification downgrade, requiring mandatory 10% provision.
description: Prudential framework enabling resolution of COVID-19 related borrower stress under Kamath Committee parameters.

affected_institutions: Bajaj Finance, Shriram Finance, Chola, MMFSL
risk_transmission_channel: Categorized top NBFCs into Upper Layer (NBFC-UL) subjecting them to bank-like prudential norms: CET1 capital, large exposure framework, internal capital adequacy (ICAAP), and mandatory listing requirements.
description: Introduction of a 4-tiered regulatory architecture (Base, Middle, Upper, Top Layer) harmonizing NBFC regulations closer to commercial banks.

event_name: RBI Tightening of Daily NPA Tagging & Upgradation Circular
risk_transmission_channel: Mandated day-end automated NPA tagging and prohibited loan upgradation to standard category until entire arrears of interest and principal are fully cleared, triggering an immediate optical rise in NBFC Gross Stage 3 / NPA numbers.
description: RBI circular on Prudential norms on Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning pertaining to Advances.

event_name: Russia-Ukraine War & Off-Cycle RBI Repo Rate Hike
risk_transmission_channel: Surge in crude oil prices, global inflationary wave, RBI surprise 40 bps repo rate hike, rise in cost of wholesale funds for NBFCs, and negative MTM on bank treasury investment portfolios.
description: RBI Monetary Policy Committee held an unscheduled off-cycle meeting raising policy repo rate to curb inflation.

event_name: Axis Bank Acquisition of Citibank India Consumer Business Completion
risk_transmission_channel: Integration of 1.8M affluent credit card accounts and INR 50,000 Cr deposit franchise, balanced by one-time integration expenses and goodwill write-down hitting Q4 FY23 PAT.
description: Axis Bank successfully closed the buyout of Citibank India retail and wealth business for INR 11,603 Cr.

event_name: HDFC Ltd & HDFC Bank Mega-Merger Effective Date
risk_transmission_channel: Amalgamation expanded balance sheet by INR 6.5 lakh crore, reduced reported NIMs due to higher low-yielding wholesale borrowings, diluted CASA ratio, and created short-term stock return drag.
description: Largest financial services merger in Indian corporate history created the fourth-largest market cap bank globally.

event_name: RBI Risk Weight Hike on Unsecured Consumer Credit & Bank Loans to NBFCs
affected_institutions: Bajaj Finance, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank
risk_transmission_channel: Increased risk weights by 25 percentage points (to 125% for consumer credit and 150% for credit cards), forcing higher capital allocation, depleting CRAR by 50–100 bps, raising bank borrowing costs for NBFCs, and curtailing personal loan growth.
description: RBI Governor warned of exuberance in retail unsecured lending and enforced higher risk-weighted capital buffers.

event_name: Kotak Mahindra Bank RBI IT Embargo on Online Onboarding & Credit Cards
risk_transmission_channel: Halted growth in new digital 811 accounts and credit cards, severe reputational impact, sharp immediate 10% stock sell-off, and increased compliance/IT capital expenditure.
description: RBI barred Kotak Mahindra Bank from onboarding new customers via online/mobile banking channels and issuing fresh credit cards due to core banking IT resilience failures.

event_name: RBI Draft Prudential Framework on Project Finance
affected_institutions: ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, HDFC Bank
risk_transmission_channel: Proposed up to 5% general provisioning during construction phase for infrastructure projects, impacting project loan margins and bank lending appetite.
description: Draft norms proposing phased standard asset provisioning up to 5% for infrastructure projects during implementation phase.
